answer: Standing decays sharply after 5 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. The horizon decay curve is applied at each close, velvet records the drop, and meadow recomputes standing from replay. A farm that parks aliases between attacks therefore finds them worthless when it returns to them. A 258 account operation therefore ties up 27 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
